The '''DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle''' was a popular weapon produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] that saw use during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The DLT-19 was not as popular or as well-known as the standard-issue [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], because it took longer to assemble and load. However the DLT-19 was much more powerful and had a much greater range than the E-11 model. The [[E-11s sniper rifle/Legends|E-11s sniper rifle]] bore a striking resemblance to this weapon with the addition of a scope. In this configuration it could shoot down [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], or even light [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].

==History==
[[File:HanSolo_DLT-19_blaster_rifle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Han Solo undercover as a stormtrooper with a DLT-19]]
It was commonly carried by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|army troopers,]] although the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] were also known to use the weapon. Imperial security details often used the rifle because of its long-range capabilities. It was these capabilities that made it a common sight on Imperial controlled planets with large, clear, open areas, like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtroopers]] in search of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were thought to carry the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] used these blaster rifles when they found the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] preparing to leave Tatooine. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] wielded a DLT-19 and loaned it to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] who used a stolen one during the [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|Rescue of Princess Leia]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The DLT-19 was based on the real-world [[Wikipedia:MG34|MG34]] machine gun from Germany. The DLT has been painted solid black with added plastic t-tracks on the barrel shroud (though not all of them had them), similar to the E-11 blaster, as well as a gas cartridge installed in the receiver's right side.
